classification: Separate test-quality observations; not additional confirmed financial vulnerabilities or Security plugin results

observations.title: Concurrent last-admin self-revocation test retains seeded third administrator
observations.trigger: Fresh NoOwnerSetup starts normal server on empty database; demo manager/all exists. Two explicitly seeded managers revoke their own users_manage concurrently, while demo admin untouched.
observations.root_cause: Test omits LeaveOnlyOneAdministratorAsync or equivalent exact-admin setup. Assert.Single successful responses encodes two-admin precondition not established.
observations.expected_actual_static: Both named revocations can legitimately succeed while seeded third admin survives. The final CanManageUsers assertion can pass on demo account. This can produce test failure despite correct invariant; no runtime failure claimed.
observations.correction_design: Explicitly remove seeded extra admins, assert exact initial set of two administrator IDs, synchronize request overlap, require exactly one successful revoke and inspect surviving named admin plus correct rejection status.
observations.regression_tests: Run only approved isolated SQL fixture; compare scenario with two admins against scenario with deliberate third admin, where two self-revocations should both be allowed.
observations.counterevidence: NoOwnerSetup means no owner, not empty administrator catalog. Helper comment explicitly acknowledges seeded admin. No evidence of configuration override disabling DemoSeeder in FalahApiFactory.
observations.independent_challenge: Parent notified with source chain; confirmation pending.

observations.title: Last-admin deactivation test ends in independently forbidden self-deactivation
observations.trigger: Final request sets second user inactive while ActorUserId is same second user, after first user deactivated.
observations.root_cause: Self-deactivation guard already rejects this exact final operation regardless last-admin lockout protection; test cannot distinguish absence of latter guard.
observations.expected_actual_static: Test could pass if last-admin deactivation guard were removed while self-deactivation remains. Current source does not demonstrate production lockout failure.
observations.correction_design: Design an authorized distinct actor/target scenario or pure policy/transaction test isolating administrator-cardinality check, and verify expected failure reason. If self guard makes endpoint state unreachable, document redundancy rather than claim independent coverage.
observations.regression_tests: Controlled mutation test or policy unit fixture proving last-admin branch reached; no app patch performed. Preserve positive case disabling one of multiple admins.
observations.counterevidence: Self-deactivation is intentionally denied and other tests cover it. This observation limits coverage claim, not business behavior.

observations.title: Delivery fee freeze test edits an unrelated service and never checks fee
observations.trigger: Create new service fee1500, checkout via helper46-61 whose request uses svc-1 and fee0, edit new service to5000, then assert order.ServiceId svc-1.
observations.root_cause: Wrong target service and assertion only ID, no DeliveryFeePiastres/Total or print snapshot.
observations.expected_actual_static: Could pass if historical amounts using edited service were rewritten; no production rewrite bug established.
observations.correction_design: Checkout using actual newly created service with nonzero fee; mutate that same service; assert original fee,total and ticket snapshots unchanged.
observations.regression_tests: Approved isolated fixture only: compare new order uses5000 versus original retains1500; assert update success and both service IDs equal intended testservice.
observations.counterevidence: Comment1013-1014 acknowledges DIFFERENT service, narrowing actual guarantee to unrelated-service edit isolation; helper always hardcodes svc-1.

observations.title: Reprint attribution assertion reuses a name already present on original ticket
observations.trigger: Original CashierHeader135-138 already cashier manager name; MarkAsReprint516 uses same actor; Contains527 checks that name anywhere.
observations.root_cause: Actor presence precondition already satisfied by original content; requested timestamp also not asserted.
observations.expected_actual_static: Could pass if reprint operation omitted actor/time metadata while still adding banners. No production omission proven.
observations.correction_design: Use distinct reprint actor absent from original, exact expected local timestamp, inspect each cut-separated piece attribution and deep-compare original immutable composition.
observations.regression_tests: Pure composition regression cases one/two pieces, different cashier and reprint operator, expected hour/date boundary.
observations.counterevidence: Banner count/start/aftercut and original banner absence are substantive tests retained; this only limits attribution/time proof.

observations.title: Shared consumption test leaves average and variance numerical correctness unasserted
observations.trigger: Insert Usage10000 over explicit three-day range with standard4000, require consumed10000 and merely nonnull average/variance.
observations.root_cause: Expected numerical results absent; comment calls approx3333 above4000 though it is below.
observations.expected_actual_static: Wrong nonnull metrics could pass; actual endpoint arithmetic not proven wrong by this test gap.
observations.correction_design: Freeze from/to, assert documented day denominator and exact rounded daily average plus signed variance; remove misleading arithmetic comment.
observations.regression_tests: Three days, fractional duration, inclusive/exclusive boundaries, zero/negative range, usage type and Direction sign; no execution performed.
observations.counterevidence: Consumed and standard quantities do have exact assertions; application may correctly compute metrics despite weaker test.
